name: campaign_battlecard
description: Generates comprehensive competitive battlecards for SailPoint against a named competitor: positioning, why-we-win proof points, objection handling and displacement / why-we-win messaging. Use for "battlecard", "position against CyberArk", "how do we beat Okta", or competitive displacement asks. NOT for brainstorming campaign themes, writing a full campaign brief, or analysing how past campaigns performed.

skills.name: Competitive Battlecard
skills.description: Produces a full competitive battlecard for SailPoint versus a specified competitor, covering competitor overview, SailPoint strengths, weaknesses to exploit, objection handling, landmines and displacement messaging.
examples: Build a battlecard for SailPoint against CyberArk
Position us against Okta for a mid-market identity governance deal
How do we win against Saviynt?
